summary: Ecopetrol S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing the publication of its Year-End Periodic Report for fiscal year 2025, as required by Colombian regulations. The report covers financial, operational, governance, social, and environmental performance for the year ended December 31, 2025, along with a legal representative's certification. No special-situations event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, or capital return is disclosed. This is a routine regulatory filing by a foreign private issuer, equivalent to an annual report distribution under U.S. securities law. No transaction, deal terms, or event that would trigger classification under any special-situations category is present.
